notes: This profile describes a GENERIC bidirectional steerable ablation catheter.
It is not a model of any specific commercial device.
Geometric similarity does not imply mechanical accuracy.
Every null value below is CALIBRATION_REQUIRED and blocks simulation.

2026-09-09: outer dimensions updated from a public manufacturer table supplied by the project owner (8 F, 3.5 mm tip, 6 electrodes, 115 cm). The project proposal PDF states 7.5 Fr / 4 electrodes for the same device class - that discrepancy must be resolved in the proposal.

electrodes.source: count: PUBLIC_MANUFACTURER_TABLE_USER_SUPPLIED; spacing: ESTIMATED_FROM_PRODUCT_PHOTO (+/-0.5 mm, ring widths not resolvable) - USER_MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED
electrodes.layout_note: Tip electrode, then a cluster of three ring electrodes, a gap, then two ring electrodes. Centres from the tip apex, scaled to the 3.5 mm tip electrode in the photo.

provenance.geometry_source: size (8 F), tip length (3.5 mm), electrode count (6), length (115 cm): public manufacturer product table supplied by the project owner on 2026-09-09; electrode spacing and port layout: ESTIMATED_FROM_PRODUCT_PHOTO; active/deflectable length: not in the table (class-level placeholder)
provenance.geometry_note: Geometric similarity is not mechanical accuracy. Still not a model of any specific commercial device: no mechanical value has been measured.

units.damping_n_s_per_mm: N s / mm^2 (per unit length; key name fixed by contract)
units.torsional_damping_n_mm_s_per_rad: N mm s / rad per unit length
units.steer_gain_rad_per_mm: rad/mm per unit steering input (= rest curvature gain)
